messages:
mira: paging on-call, we are seeing routing failures for a subset of enterprise customers in EU dedicated region — calls and webhook deliveries to routing endpoints are failing with 502/timeout. Incident bot just paged. (1854326789)

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-07. Severity: S1. Affected service: contact-router-eu-dedicated. Pager sent to @samir oncall. Links: https://internal.ops/INC-2026-07

samir: on it, looking at logs now. first hypothesis: upstream load balancer started returning 503s to the router (seen ~1854326740 onwards). grabbing rolling logs.

mira: heads-up — top impacted enterprise list from initial telemetry: Sentinel Health (ENT-0471), Novara Health (ENT-0823), Corbin Finance (ENT-0910). Their configured contact routing uses dedicated pools in eu-west-1.

samir: confirmed LB 503s + router worker OOMs on 3/6 pods. tail of router logs: ```ERROR: dispatch failed: write tcp 10.12.4.7:443: write: connection reset by peer
Memory usage spiked around 12:03 UTC after a large burst from a batch job.```

jen: replicating locally against dedicated routing stack, I can reproduce connection resets when KV cache misses explode. possible cascading retry storm.

samir: mitigation plan: 1) scale contact-router-eu-dedicated replicas + disable retry-on-502 for enterprise routes 2) roll back last config that increased prefetch window (deployed 11:58) 3) apply temporary traffic-shear rule to send ENT-0471/0823/0910 to fallback pool. executing step 1 now.

ops-bot: action: scaled contact-router-eu-dedicated from 6->12 replicas (1854326860).

samir: performing config rollback for prefetch window (running `kubectl apply -f contact-router-config-rollback.yaml --namespace=dedicated-eu`). ETA ~3m.

mira: while that happens, we need a short tailored customer notification and a status page update. @kevin-cs can you prep the customer-facing wording? I drafted a short template below.

kevin-cs: posting suggested templates — please review/approve.

kevin-cs: CUSTOMER EMAIL (short):
Subject: Incident affecting contact routing for your Dedicated EU capacity

Hi <Customer name>,

We are investigating an issue impacting contact routing for dedicated EU capacity. Some inbound routes and webhook deliveries may fail or be delayed. Our engineers are applying mitigations now and we expect partial restoration within 15–30 minutes. We will update you again shortly or when service is fully restored.

Tailored impact notes (for each customer):
- Sentinel Health (ENT-0471): inbound email-to-call routing and webhooks are intermittently failing. Workarounds: retry webhook deliveries or use the fallback endpoint documented in your onboarding guide.
- Novara Health (ENT-0823): outbound contact handoffs to SIP endpoints may experience 5–10s delays; we are not seeing data loss.
- Corbin Finance (ENT-0910): scheduled outbound batches may be delayed if they hit the affected routing pool.

We apologize for the disruption — Kevin, Customer Success

samir: rolling back config completed (1854326930). observing immediate reduction in OOM churn. keeping replicas pinned while we monitor.

status.page.bot: Proposed status page update ready for review:

[START STATUS COPY]
Incident INC-2026-07: Contact routing errors in EU Dedicated region (ongoing)
Impact: A subset of enterprise customers may experience failed or delayed contact routing and webhook deliveries.
Mitigation: We have scaled the routing service, reverted a recent config change, and applied traffic routing to fallback pools for the most impacted customers.
ETA for broader restoration: 15–30 minutes.
We will post another update within 30 minutes or sooner if there is a material change.
[END STATUS COPY]

mira: approve for status page as-is. For customer emails, approve the tailored lines above. Add line to offer a short 1:1 support session for high-touch customers?

kevin-cs: added: "If you'd like, we can schedule a 15-min call to walk through impacts and mitigation steps."

samir: monitoring metrics: error rate down ~70% after rollback + scale. still seeing occasional 502s for ENT-0910 due to queued requests in fallback. moving to remediation: drain old pods and bring healthy nodes into service.

jen: I pushed a temporary rate-limit rule for enterprise prefetches to reduce burstiness (rule id rl-temp-2026).

mira: OK — next steps: get status page live, send targeted customer emails (kevin to send), continue mitigation until green. I'll coordinate on-call handoff in 30 min.

kevin-cs: sending emails now to ENT-0471/0823/0910 contacts (sent 1854326998). copy of email thread: ```To: sentinel-support@sentinel.health CC: ops@redwood.com Subject: Incident affecting contact routing for your Dedicated EU capacity...```

status.page.bot: Status page updated to "Identified" and customer emails queued (1854327005).

samir: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline for ENT-0471 and ENT-0823, ENT-0910 still has intermittent 502s tied to a specific backend. digging into backend pool health.

mira: handing off to @samir for ongoing remediation — I will take next-oncall in 30 min. Please keep the status page and customer threads updated. If ENT-0910 still not green by 1854327300, escalate to platform SRE and prepare extended-downtime comms.

samir: confirmed handoff accepted (1854327035). continuing investigation on ENT-0910 backend. Will post updates in this thread.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-07: Severity remains S1. Owner: samir. Handoff: mira -> samir.
